Wow, that’s amazing. Is that mode of transportation serious times or random goofiness? Also, is it just me or is Captain America’s leg positioning really feminine? I’m trying to decide if it would be more or less awkward if he were just kinda hanging there all ragdoll-like.

There are multiple instances of this travel arrangement. And just for funsies: Loki riding Thor.

Realistically, if they’re hovering like that, even if Iron Man is strong enough to do hold up Cap with just his arm in the suit, that much pressure on one spot would be uncomfortable, even for a super soldier. Iron Man is going to be at least partly supporting Cap’s weight on his hip, to help distribute that pressure. And if that’s the case, it makes sense for Cap’s legs to be positioned off from each other. Though thinking about it I THINK his inside, not outside, leg should be the one bent, because you would cock the hip that’s resting on the carrier to provide a wider surface to rest on. And really Iron Man should have his inner hip cocked a little too, for the same reason. Better surface to carry on. (Not that I’m over thinking this or anything)
It’s also more visually interesting and pleasant than if he’s just hanging there.
